notes.title: Hints and Tips #2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Upgrades[/b][/h1]

The fast action Racing Game “Rally Racers” allows you to upgrade your cars. You are rewarded Coins and Diamonds for Stunts, Placings and collecting Oranges and these can be spent on upgrades.

Upgrade your car and make it superfast or increase your stunt ability.
Win your next car by collecting all the Gold cups on every level.
Beat the Evil Droog and move to the next world in a challenging head to head race.

notes.title: Mac OSX Release
notes.content:
[h1][b]Rally Racers is now available on Mac OSX![/b][/h1]

The Mac OS release is fully up to date with the Windows version, including all 8 different playable characters, 8 companions with unique abilities and a grand total of 28 different tracks across 7 unique locations, there is many hours of incredible game play to be had. See if you can beat team Droog!

This release has a full 50 steam achievements spread throughout the game, and fully functional leaderboards for each track. Join in now and see if you can collect all the oranges and become the fastest racer on all tracks! There are many hours of gameplay to be had.

We also have 8 Unique steam trading cards for you to earn and trade in the steam community with 6 steam badges to be crafted. There are a total of 5 beautiful profile backgrounds and 5 unique emoticons featuring in-game items and characters from Droog to the collectable oranges!

Join in now and see if you can be a racing star!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/514530/Rally_Racers/

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Rally Racers has been updated, and there are some new features!

This update provides the following changes:
* New awards for the final 3 locations. There is now 3 more golden rugby balls to be won by getting all gold trophies in each location
* Awards Menu, you can now see all the in-game awards that you have earned through a single menu. This shows all the cars you have unlocked and the rugby balls that you have won!
* Adjusted the positions of oranges on some tracks
* Minor graphical updates regarding the in-race HUD

notes.title: Hints and Tips #1
notes.content:
New for 2018 the crazy fast action racing game that is “Rally Racers”. 

Your quest takes you through seven wonderful worlds and along the way you have the choice of companions who each have individual skills to help you win.
[list]
    [*]Pick up weapons and power boosts to defend or attack your opponents. 
    [*]Gain more power by performing stunts and win cups for achieving goals.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Rally Racers has been updated, fixing some bugs, adjusting some settings and adding some new features please read on for further details.

This update provides the following changes:
* Updated splash screen logos
* Added display resolution options into settings menu, capped at 1920 width due to issues with higher resolution screens
* Adjusted the positions of oranges on some tracks
* Fixed major bug with track completion on the last 3 locations, can now achieve all awards correctly
* Minor graphical updates regarding UI

Also we would like to inform everyone that the in-game micro transactions should work correctly again. The purchasing server was temporarily down for updates and maintenance and has now been restored. 

P.S Please stay tuned as the Mac OSX  version is nearing completion and will be announced very soon.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Update Notice: Large update has been pushed, please read on for details

There have been some updates to Rally Racers with regards to the leader boards. It is now much easier to identify the track the leader board is for as numbers are now displayed alongside the track name. 

Also there have been some graphical updates to improve the tool tips for players using controllers and a few other graphical improvements with the in-race HUD.

notes.title: New Rally Racers Trailers
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We have released 4 new trailers for Rally Racers, you can check them out on the store page (see bottom of post for link)

These trailers show a whole bunch of in-game content, such as companions and their abilities, collectable oranges and performing stunts to earn trophies, and even hints on how to find the hidden collectable oranges!

Along side all this amazing content is some content of actual gameplay, showing some of the amazing racing. Go along to the store page now and join in with all the fun to be had!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/514530/Rally_Racers/

notes.content:

Freeze, confuse and race your way to a whole set of cards.

Buy now and, get playing to start collecting your trading cards!

Also we will be releasing a Mac OS X build very soon, with full controller support so stay tuned!

notes.title: Rally Racers Full Release Launched
notes.content:
Exciting news!

Rally Racers is no longer early access and is in full release. Join in and race against Droog and his evil Henchmen! 

With 8 different playable characters, 8 companions with unique abilities and a grand total of 28 different tracks across 7 unique locations, there is many hours of incredible game play to be had. See if you can beat team Droog!

The game also contains 50 achievements spread throughout the game and leaderboards so you can compete with the community! Additionally it contains micro-transactions for those who want extra help to rise up the leaderboards!

Stay tuned as we will also be releasing a full set of steam trading cards very soon!
